approved_by: Project owner via direct Ticket 36 implementation instruction
rights_basis: The project owner authorized implementation of the exact Ticket 36 experiment by direct instruction. This project-level approval covers only this bounded CPU experiment using the already acquired and independently verified checkpoint; it is not a third-party rights grant or a legal determination, and it does not authorize final-candidate freeze or release.
rights_status_semantics: Eligible records the project owner's authorization for this exact Ticket 36 experimental use only. It is not a third-party rights grant or legal determination and does not clear any release action.

scope_details.cohort: Use the 58 corrected gold studies and 4,170 complete-input report studies. Exclude the eight Ticket 35 studies with recorded incomplete image inputs and preserve their counts and UID-set digest.
scope_details.data_access: Use the existing RSNA archive and Ticket 35 prepared-series cache read-only. Do not access or download ImageNet source images or raw report text during model training.
scope_details.experiment: Ticket 36 only: the frozen three-fold comparison of reference-only training against Ticket 30 admitted Ticket 16 Astra report supervision on complete-input Ticket 35 images.
scope_details.model_use: Reuse the exact verified ResNet-18 ImageNet-1K V1 checkpoint with a frozen encoder; fit only fold-specific heads under the frozen matched training configuration.
scope_details.processing: Offline CPU Slurm only, at most two concurrent 16-CPU, 64-GiB, six-hour allocations, with no external spend or GPU allocation.
scope_details.release: This experimental-use request does not authorize candidate promotion, final-candidate freeze, publication, redistribution or release; each remains blocked pending its separate gate.
scope_details.storage: Stay within the frozen 2,000,000,000,000-byte soft storage budget.
